kya_hai: Seetal ne saikdon asli audio (kahani, gaane, vlog, horror) naap kar jo seekha — poora gyaan ek jagah. Har local engine isse padh kar wahi quality laa sakta hai.
niyam: asli audio sirf seekhne ke liye — copy/use nahi
patch ke baad output verify karo (chupchap fail hota hai)

robotic_ke_5_karan: pitch shift se formants khisakte hain (chipmunk/monster) → resample + formant soch
comb-filter reverb (17/23/31 ms) = goonj → reverb band ya smooth tail
line ke andar lambi khamoshi = 'ruk-ruk kar bolna' → 110 ms se lambi gap 65 ms karo
line ke shuru/aakhir ki silence trim nahi = har line ke baad hole
mid patla + high chubhta = hollow/machine awaaz (mid 55–65%, high ≤20%)
smoothness_rules: har line: trim 25–40 ms → andar ki 80 ms+ gap ko 35 ms karo → 20 ms fade-in
lines ke beech pause 0.22–0.35 s (1.5 s nahi)
humanize me amplitude micro-dips band (woh shabd kaat dete hain)
target: andar ke 80 ms+ gaps ≤5, pace 12–14 akshar/s, speech 65–70%
smooth reference ka target: low 15–17, mid 55–57, high 27–30%, brightness 2086–2187 Hz, RMS -18.5 dBFS

bhaav_ke_signal.note: hasi ko sur se nahi, 3–8 Hz modulation se pakdo; darr ko jitter se; cheekh ko high band se

shabd_galat.problem: piper ka Hindi G2P: व girta hai, ि→े, ठ→ख/त, श→ष, ौ→ो
shabd_galat.hal: respell dictionary + carrier-phrase test (अब सुनो, <शब्द>) — akela shabd ASR se test nahi hota

sabak: sparse beat bhi beat hai — khaali jagah gayak ke liye

galtiyan_jo_ki: pitch shift se goonj aayi (comb reverb + phasiness)
background 0.30 par tha → khamoshi hi nahi bachi
CAST patch chupchap fail hua → dadi 240 Hz par reh gayi
length_scale 1.4+ kar diya → ruk-ruk kar bolna
line ke andar ki 1 s+ gaps compress nahi kiye
smoothness ke liye sirf gaps compress kiye, piper ke noise_w/length_scale ko nahi chhua — isliye phir ruk-ruk laga
main 'garam/dull' EQ ki taraf chali gayi (mid 69, high 9) — Swag ka smooth reference bright hai, isliye ruk-ruk lagta tha

duniya_ki_awaaz.niyam: jis cheez ka zikr ho, usi ki awaaz background me ubhare — nadi, hawa, barish, patte, chidaiyan, jhingur, kadam, gaon
duniya_ki_awaaz.kaise: script ke shabd → sound map; har line ke hisaab se gain 2.4x tak; 1.2 s smooth fade (chatka nahi)
duniya_ki_awaaz.levels: bed speech se 10–14 dB neeche (SNR 12–22 dB)
duniya_ki_awaaz.sabak: sirf ek flat bed nahi — duniya badalti rehni chahiye, warna scene mar jata hai

smooth_reference.kya_hai: SMOOTH reference — Swag ke banwaye hue jungle-nadi-safar v5/v8 (Sarvam) ka naap. Local engines ko isi ke kareeb laana hai.
sabak: smooth reference KAALI/dull nahi hai — bright 2086–2187 Hz (mera local 1157 tha)
mid 55–57%, high 27–30% — yahi 'khula, clear' sunai deta hai
gaps reference me bhi hain (mean 104–180 ms) — matlab 'ruk-ruk' gaps se nahi, DULLNESS se lagta hai
local ko match karne ke liye: presence +2.3 dB @3.2k, air +1.45 dB @6.2k, de-ess @7.5k, air bed layer
